3. Financial Conditions Signal?

Overall conditions not tightening, supporting equity leadership.

Defensives lag: XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -2.78% | 1M: -4.46%) and XLP CORRECTION (1W: -2.32% | 1M: +0.55%).

China showing 1M strength but 1W pause: FXI CORRECTION (1W: -0.11% | 1M: +11.05%).

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation present but selective: IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.88% | 1M: +1.21%) and IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.06% | 1M: +1.63%) showing appetite; ARKK RECOVERY (1W: +7.93% | 1M: -6.17%) indicates shorter-term rotation into thematic names.  
Small caps participation exists but remains below leading tech momentum.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Industrial metals and broad commodities strong: CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.52% | 1M: +9.25%) and DBB ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.52% | 1M: +6.19%).  
Precious metals also strong: GLD ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.00% | 1M: +3.22%) and PALL ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.48% | 1M: +7.87%).

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy shows short-term weakness against a stronger 1M: XLE CORRECTION (1W: -2.28% | 1M: +4.89%) and BNO CORRECTION (1W: -9.95% | 1M: +8.30%).  
Natural gas remains weak: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -1.91% | 1M: -17.18%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Core risk-on signals — SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.53% | 1M: +2.95%), XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.61% | 1M: +3.76%) — align with falling VXX ↓ falling (1W: -12.43% | 1M: -5.44%).  
DIVERGENCE: Several 1W vs 1M mismatches in energy/China (FXI, BNO, XLE) constitute MINOR divergences but warrant monitoring.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor growth/momentum exposure: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.61% | 1M: +3.76%) and QQQ ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.40% | 1M: +1.11%), and selective cyclicals like XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.25% | 1M: +4.99%).  
Reduce exposure to lagging defensives and weak energy: XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -2.78% | 1M: -4.46%) and XLE CORRECTION (1W: -2.28% | 1M: +4.89%).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

BULLISH: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.61% | 1M: +3.76%), XME ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.70% | 1M: +9.22%), CPER ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.52% | 1M: +9.25%).  
BEARISH: XLE CORRECTION (1W: -2.28% | 1M: +4.89%), XLU BELOW TREND (1W: -2.78% | 1M: -4.46%), XLP CORRECTION (1W: -2.32% | 1M: +0.55%).

12. Commodities to Watch?

BEARISH: BNO CORRECTION (1W: -9.95% | 1M: +8.30%), UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -1.91% | 1M: -17.18%).

13. Key Levels?  
VXX at ~20 area (VXX ↓ falling (1W: -12.43% | 1M: -5.44%) BELOW TREND) is a complacency threshold to monitor; HYG/LQD dynamics (HYG ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.84% | 1M: +0.18%) vs LQD RECOVERY (1W: +0.92% | 1M: -0.63%)) signal credit health.  
Tech vs Financials pivot: XLK/XLF (Tech vs Financials Level 3.2053, 1W: +3.97% | 1M: -2.87% RECOVERY) is a key style ratio to watch.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive and VXX ↓ falling (1W: -12.43% | 1M: -5.44%) with SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.53% | 1M: +2.95%) confirming.  
Tech and growth showing strength — XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.61% | 1M: +3.76%) and QQQ ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.40% | 1M: +1.11%).  
Key risk: 1W/1M divergences in energy and China (XLE CORRECTION (1W: -2.28% | 1M: +4.89%), FXI CORRECTION (1W: -0.11% | 1M: +11.05%)) that warrant monitoring.
